pr_title: core: remove refcount for bpf program
pr_body:
kernel already implements this. Thus the ref count we keep for
bpf-program is redundant.

This PR removes ref count for bpf program as part of a task to simplify
bpf-program and remove redundancies, which will make the switch to
code-compiled BPF programs easier.

Part of #19270
pr_comments: Did the kernel always implement this, or is it a recent addition?
Please refer to this article for refcount in the kernel. https://facebookmicrosites.github.io/bpf/blog/2018/08/31/object-lifetime.html. It has been there at least three years.
Please split the commit description into a one-line title (not more than ~60 characters), an empty line, and the rest of the description.

> Please refer to this article for refcount in the kernel. https://facebookmicrosites.github.io/bpf/blog/2018/08/31/object-lifetime.html. It has been there at least three years.

Sorry but I don't really have time to delve into long blog posts, and "3 years" doesn't really answer the question. Does every kernel that supports BPF also do refcounting implicitly?
Also, this PR is not currently ready for review. Sorry for any misunderstanding.

@bluca 

> Did the kernel always implement this, or is it a recent addition?

Yes

> Sorry but I don't really have time to delve into long blog posts, and "3 years" doesn't really answer the question. Does every kernel that supports BPF also do refcounting implicitly?

Yes

refcnt has been supported since the dawn of ebpf, i.e. 3.18. 
Please take a look at `struct bpf_prog_aux` [refcnt field](https://elixir.bootlin.com/linux/v3.18.140/source/include/linux/bpf.h#L123) also at [kernel/bpf/syscall.c](https://elixir.bootlin.com/linux/v3.18.140/source/kernel/bpf/syscall.c#L445). refcnt is increased by `bpf_prog_get` and reset by `bpf_prog_put`.

I think this is on track to get merged so please publish it to take it out of draft.

Also update the PR and commit message so as not to close #19270 (maybe write "Part of #19270"). This PR only handles one of the items on the list.
This PR should be ready for review now. Thanks!

issue_context.title: bpf: deprecate user space refcount
issue_context.body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
Opening an issue for @keszybz proposal https://github.com/systemd/systemd/pull/13496#pullrequestreview-632304667 for steps to simplify the existing BPF infrastructure.


**Describe the solution you'd like**
1. Stop tracking ref count of bpf programs in user space, since kernel already does that, deprecate `bpf_program_ref`, `bpf_program_unref` helpers.
2.  Introduce (`attach_type`, `fd`) tuple as a handle identifying  a program loaded to the kernel. Simplify `struct BPFProgram`, so it stores only bpf instructions related fields and doesn't have key semantics.
3.  Apply the above to BPF features: bpf-firewall, bpf-devices, bpf-foreign.

If you still want to move, please do it in a separate commit to sort out refactoring an functional changes
